subject: Promo credit request — additional credits & account history
messages:
From: Samir Patel <trialops@codecove.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@codecove.io
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're close to a decision but need a bit more time and usage to validate 1) the multi-tenant isolation and 2) the latency profile with longer contexts. The dev team is almost out of credits on our current test org. Can you approve another $2,000 in trial credits and extend the trial window by two weeks? We can loop procurement if you need an MSA or purchase intent note.

We've run multiple short tests over the last month; happy to provide usage logs. Would appreciate a fast yes so we don't stall the POC.

— Samir
TrialOps, CodeCove
Attachments: usage_history.csv
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <trialops@codecove.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation

Samir —

Thanks for the context. I can escalate, but I need a short account history from you: are these credits for one project/org or multiple trial accounts? Also can procurement confirm that the PoC will convert to a paid pilot if performance checks out?

Marissa & Vivek — can you pull account logs and check for repeat trial provisioning or multiple trial orgs associated with CodeCove? I want to be sure we're not repeatedly topping up an account pattern we've seen elsewhere.

If we approve, standard approach is a targeted bridge credit (max $2k) plus a tighter expiry and a simple T&C acknowledgement (no stacking of promos, single-use). If ops flags abuse, we should decline and offer a paid pilot discount instead.

—Sean
Sr. Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation

Quick summary after initial check:
- Found three trial accounts in the last 90 days tied to the same billing email pattern and two similar billing addresses.
- Usage spikes coincide with new account creation; pattern looks like short-lived bursts to exhaust credits.
- Customer name on record matches CodeCove, but we have distinct account IDs.

I attached a CSV with normalized usage rows. Recommend fraud ops review (Vivek). If ops signs off, I can offer a $2k bridge with a 7-day expiry and require signed terms (DocuSign).

Attachment: usage_history.csv

Marissa
Acct Exec — Enterprise Sales
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation (fraud ops findings)

I pulled deeper telemetry and flagged deviations:
- Same payment instrument hash reused across four different trial orgs in the last 60 days.
- Slight variation in billing address strings but same IP block and overlapping device fingerprints.
- One account shows rapid token consumption consistent with scripted load tests designed to exhaust promo credits.

Recommendation: DECLINE unconditional promo top-up. Offer an alternative: a timeboxed paid pilot (30 days) with a small bridging credit (applied to invoice) only after procurement signs a purchase order or pilot agreement. That reduces abuse risk and converts to a paid relationship.

I've attached a short ops report and included a link to the internal account dashboard for your review.

Attachment: fraud_report_20261210.pdf
Link: https://redwood-internal/dashboard/account-echo?acct=codecove

Vivek
Senior Fraud Ops Analyst
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <trialops@codecove.io>
Cc: procurement@codecove.io, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation

Samir —

Appreciate the ask and for sending usage. After an internal review we have evidence of multiple trial orgs associated with the same underlying payment instrument and scripted consumption patterns. Because of that, we can't approve an additional unconditional promo credit.

We are, however, willing to support a focused paid pilot:
- 30-day pilot (single org) with a $2,000 credit applied as invoice credit after PO/signing
- No additional promotional stacking; pilot must be on a single pinned account and procurement must sign the pilot agreement (DocuSign link below)
- Pilot will include basic observability for cost & latency; we can set token caps to avoid surprise overages

DocuSign for pilot terms: https://www.docusign.com/en/traffic-link/placeholder
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Codecove-6789

If you can get procurement to sign, we can stand this up quickly. If your team prefers a free extension instead, I'm afraid we have to decline given the abuse signals.

—Sean
From: Anya Choudhury <procurement@codecove.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <trialops@codecove.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation

Sean —

I understand your position, but CodeCove is under time pressure. Samir informs me the PoC cannot complete without another 2 weeks of credits. If Redwood refuses, we'll evaluate other vendors who are less restrictive. We're willing to sign a PO, but a signed PO will take time and we won't get the usage window we need. Can you escalate for a one-time exception while we process procurement? A short 7-day provisional top-up while PO is in flight would be ideal.

Please advise — this is a high priority for our CPO.

Thanks,
Anya
Head of Procurement, CodeCove
